ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A person going from Beijing to Chongqing can take a train, can also take an airplane, and can also first take a train to Wuhan, then take a ship along the Yangtze River to Chongqing, as shown in the figure. In these two cases:
① His motion trajectories are different ② The distances he has traveled are the same ③ His position changes are different ④ His displacements are the same
The correct statements above are ( )
A.①② 
B.③④ 
C.①④ 
D.②③
